tool: Built-in image_gen imagegen, through the Codex CLI
references: A sheet of the desktop grass tufts (assets/art/ambient/tuft-left.png, tuft-right.png) for the style, and the flower's own album crop (src/art/album/flowers/<kind>.webp) for its species and colours

sources.name: tulip
sources.prompt: Use the built-in image_gen tool to make one game asset: a small planted clump of pink tulips (three or four blooms on stems, broad blue-green tulip leaves), growing out of a soft low mound of grass, in exactly the painterly style of the first reference image (soft rounded cozy cottage-garden game art, gentle warm light from the upper left, fresh greens, soft shading, no outlines). The second reference image only shows the species and its colours; keep those colours and the flower's shape, but make it a living planted clump like the first reference, not a single specimen. One clump only, centered, seen from the front, filling most of the frame, flat grass base at the bottom. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no border.

processing: pack.py: each painting keeps its largest opaque piece and the soft edge beside it, drops the faint haze, is cropped and scaled to its height in yard units at 3 sheet pixels a unit, and stands on the floor of assets/art/flowers/patches.png; it writes src/art/flowers/patch-<kind>.svg. pnpm run assets:webp makes src/art/flowers/patches.webp.
